👉Video Introduction:

Manish Chowdhary started with a ₹6.5 crore debt. It was a moment that could have ended everything. Instead, he repaid the debt and built WOW Skin Science into a household name
.
In this chat, Manish doesn't hold back. He talks about the viral hits and the science that made their brand stand out. He also gets honest about the massive losses that followed their success.

We discuss:

- Spotting trends before they blow up.
- The "Reboot Strategy" to fix a business.
- Mistakes every D2C founder should avoid.
- What it actually takes to build a brand that lasts.

If you want to know how a brand scales, fails, and evolves, dont miss this episode!
